catalogMeta.label: Find the Ten (Teen Numbers)
catalogMeta.description: A teen group of 11-19 counters arrives SCATTERED across a double frame and the child turns exactly ten of them yellow, so the ten is FOUND rather than given. CCSS K.NBT.1 decomposition: 14 is ten and four more. Concrete manipulative; no microphone needed.

fullData.title: Finding the Ten in Teen Numbers
fullData.description: Break apart numbers 16 through 19 into a group of ten and some further ones using a double ten frame.

challenges.hint: Count them out one at a time and stop at ten.
